#!/bin/bash
# Golden vector generator for /workspace/dataset/test8_executable
EXE=/workspace/dataset/test8_executable
OUT=/tmp/golden_vectors.tsv
LOG=/tmp/gen_log.txt
: > "$OUT"
: > "$LOG"

# mk N CHAR -> string of N copies of CHAR ('' when N=0)
mk() { if [ "$1" -eq 0 ]; then printf ''; else printf "%${1}s" '' | tr ' ' "$2"; fi; }

emit() {
  local payload="$1" secret="$2"
  local so se rc tok sig
  so=$("$EXE" --payload "$payload" --secret "$secret" 2>/tmp/_err); rc=$?
  se=$(cat /tmp/_err)
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    printf 'FAIL rc=%s payload=[%s] secret=[%s] stderr=[%s]\n' "$rc" "$payload" "$secret" "$se" >> "$LOG"
    return
  fi
  tok=$(printf '%s' "$so" | head -1)
  sig=$(printf '%s' "$tok" | cut -d. -f3)
  # reject anything that would corrupt the TSV
  case "$payload$secret" in
    *$'\t'*|*$'\n'*|*$'\r'*)
      printf 'SKIP(tab/nl) payload=[%s] secret=[%s]\n' "$payload" "$secret" >> "$LOG"; return ;;
  esac
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$payload" "$secret" "$sig" "$tok" >> "$OUT"
